name: LargerMaps
author: Luca
description: Standalone selectable 64/72/80/88/96 tactical maps with hash-locked native pathfinding, mission bounds and node-grid initialization for reviewed MENACE 0.7.15 through 0.7.18 builds. Unknown builds fall back to 64x64. AI changes are separate in optional AIPerformance. Terrain landmark stamps keep their vanilla world size; optional terrain stamp density on enlarged maps. Options live in the MenaceModSettings window (End key).
